preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The parents list contains exactly n-1 integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= p <= i for i, p in enumerate(parents))
preconditions.description: Each parent p_i for vertex i+1 satisfies 0 <= p_i <= i, ensuring a valid tree structure rooted at 0.
The colors list contains exactly n integers.

preconditions.expression: all(c in (0, 1) for c in colors)
preconditions.description: Each color value is either 0 (white) or 1 (black).
There is at least one black vertex in the tree.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer modulo 10^9 + 7.
The output equals the number of ways to remove a set of edges such that every resulting connected component contains exactly one black vertex, modulo 10^9 + 7.
